mode.title: Mode
mode.description: odds = current prices for the leagues you choose. movement = only the markets whose price or line changed since your last run, which is what makes this worth scheduling. leagues = the directory of sports and competitions with live event counts, which is where the league paths come from.

leaguePaths.title: League paths
leaguePaths.description: Used by odds and movement mode. Examples: football/nfl, basketball/nba, soccer/europe, tennis. A sport on its own returns every competition inside it, which can run to a thousand events, so keep the row cap in mind.

sports.title: Sports
sports.description: Leagues mode only. Which sports to list competitions for. Examples: soccer, football, basketball, tennis, baseball, hockey, esports.

marketTypes.title: Market types (optional)
marketTypes.description: Empty returns every headline market. Values: moneyline, moneyline_3way (soccer and other sports that price the draw), spread, total, other.

liveOnly.title: In-play events only
liveOnly.description: Return only events that have already started and are being priced live.

includeSuspended.title: Include suspended markets
includeSuspended.description: Off by default. A suspended market keeps its last price in the feed even though no bet can be taken on it, so leaving these in makes a frozen price look like a live quote.

includeNonMainPeriods.title: Include half and period lines
includeNonMainPeriods.description: Off by default. First half, second half and similar lines are different bets from the full game line and are easy to mistake for it.

minMovePoints.title: Minimum move
minMovePoints.description: Movement mode. Only return markets where implied probability moved at least this many percentage points. 0 returns every change.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: One row is one market on one event. The first 2 rows of every run are free.
